title: MAC-NR: LCIDs 3+4 may be SRB or DRB
description:
The spec is not that clear about whether LCID 3 may be used for
LCIDs, but I keep seeing it and want to be able to decode
these bearers.  Similarly watch out for the new SRB-4 being
configured too.

notes.body: @pquantin - we discussed this a while back - are you fine with this?

Note that R17 added an optional SRB4 that uses LCID4. It would be nice to handle it also.

Ah, I'll fix that up when I get a chance (I shabbily didn't even download a new version of TS 38.331 to check this).
